units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
summary: Static-ish handheld/tripod shot of a vine-covered wooden pergola with picnic tables in front of an outdoor basketball court and a peach building. One person (light-grey shirt, khaki trousers, grey cap) rides a black electric kick-scooter from LEFT to RIGHT across the scene, behind the front row of posts/tables, frames ~132-264. Nothing else moves except leaves and dappled shadows.

camera.motion: slow drift, not a pan: relative to frame 0 the background shifts smoothly to dx = -60 px, dy = +105 px by the last frame, with ~0.65 deg roll and ~1-1.5% apparent scale change (partly parallax). Per-frame values in camera_motion.csv.
camera.during_rider_pass_frames_132_264: background dx changes from about -31 px to -56 px (~0.2 px/frame horizontally), dy from ~+74 to +106 px
camera.file: scene/camera_motion.csv (columns dx_px, dy_px = displacement of the image-centre point vs frame 0; m00..m12 = 2x3 similarity mapping frame-0 pixel -> frame-i pixel)
camera.perspective: camera roughly level, looking horizontally; ground is the concrete slab under the pergola. The rider travels nearly parallel to the image plane: apparent height stays ~440-450 px across the whole frame. Ground contact line of the rider drifts from y~1470 (left, x~100) to y~1510 (x~1400) to y~1540 (x~2800) — slight tilt/roll plus camera dy drift, not a size change.

objects.name: rider_scooter
objects.description: Person riding a black electric kick-scooter (two small black wheels, tall stem with handlebar). Rider: grey cap, light-grey/white long-sleeve top, khaki/olive trousers, light shoes. Only moving object.
objects.visible_frames: 132-266 (scooter front enters at 132, torso fully visible from ~143, torso leaves right edge after ~260; tracked to 264; gone from 267). Lower body hidden by front tables/benches much of the time and by bushes at the far right (~frames 250-266).
objects.reference_point: x_px,y_px = centroid of the moving-mask pixels of the torso (between shoulders and hips) - the visible body centre; about 167 px below the cap top
objects.bbox_model: bbox_x0 = x_px - 138, bbox_x1 = x_px + 126 (scooter rear wheel back to front wheel front, 264 px), bbox_y0 = cap top, bbox_y1 = cap top + 450
objects.reliability: torso x within ~3-5 px on unflagged frames; manual size readings +-5 px (scooter in deep shade, partly behind benches)
